sourceRule: Root props include opts:CarouselOptions, plugins:CarouselPlugin, orientation horizontal|vertical (defaulthorizontal), setApi(api) and native div props. useEmblaCarousel8.5.2 receives opts then an axis forced from orientation, so orientation wins over opts.axis. setApi receives the actual ready API, not a fabricated index event. Internal select/reInit observations derive canScrollPrev/Next; Previous/Next compose Button with default outline/icon-sm and readable hidden Previous slide/Next slide labels. Their disabled and onClick props are applied before {...props}, so callers can deliberately override them. Item is group with roledescription=slide; Root is region roledescription=carousel and requires caller context name. Content has an outer overflow viewport and inner flex track; className styles the track. Embla supplies drag, focus/resize behavior and snapping. No autoplay is enabled unless a plugin explicitly adds it; there is no built-in pause button, pagination or live announcement. This reference chooses three static slides, nonlooping default options, no plugin and external status from actual api.select subscriptions.
keyboardAndFocus: Next/Previous use native Button Enter/Space and are disabled at the respective nonlooping boundary. Root onKeyDownCapture intercepts Left to scrollPrev and Right to scrollNext even in vertical layout; it does not implement Up/Down and does not check editable descendant targets. This reference keeps editable fields outside the carousel. Tab follows actual child/Button order; no slide roving tabindex or focus jump is invented. Caller may override the capture handler via native props. Escape does not reset the selected slide. Each slide gets an explicit positional/task label in this reference.

protocol: SCXML projects observed actual source/native transactions. Public callback names/payloads are real; _effect.* entries identify internal browser/primitive effects. It does not dispatch extra DOM events. Caller-controlled props remain authoritative, source result observations determine completion. Normal React target runs pinned original wrappers, not semantic HTML/CSS alone.
